A '''lava fountain''' was a device built by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] that shot [[Magma/Legends|lava]] into the air. A massive lava fountain was built in the center of the [[Lequana Hotel]] on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
